entries.label: The Dadra And Nagar Haveli And Daman And Diu

fields.schemeName: Mamta Taruni Abhiyan
fields.briefDescription: "Mamta Taruni Abhiyan" was a program launched in Gujarat, India, aimed at providing healthcare facilities to adolescent girls and pregnant women in rural areas. The program was launched by the Gujarat state government in 2010.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Amrutum Yojana Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Mukhyamantri Amrutum Yojana, is a health insurance scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat on 4th September 2012. It was initially launched only to cater to people who fall under the lowest income groups of the state i.e. Below Poverty Line (BPL).

fields.schemeName: AGR 3 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme For ST Farmers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “AGR 3 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme for ST Farmers” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: Uniform Assistance To SC Students
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Gujarat launched a financial Assistance scheme for the student who comes under the scheduled caste.

fields.schemeName: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of - 25 Kadaknath/R.I.R. Birds Unit To Scheduled Tribes
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of - 25 Kadaknath/R.I.R. Birds Unit to Scheduled Tribes” was launched by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Govt. of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of Scheduled Tribe People of Gujarat State.

fields.schemeName: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Weaker Section
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipend Scheme for Poultry Farming Training for Weaker Section” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to raise the income of poultry farmers by scientific poultry farming training.

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for the State Cattle Breeders” was started by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: Shri Vajpayee Bankable Yojana
fields.briefDescription: A scheme for providing financial assistance to the craftsmen of Cottage Industries through Nationalised Banks, Cooperative banks, Public sector Banks or Private Banks.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Yojana (MMKSY) is a scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat to empower women farmers in the state. The scheme was announced in the 2018-19 budget and is being implemented by the Department of Agriculture and Co-operation.

fields.schemeName: Sardar Patel Awas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Sardar Patel Awas Yojana (SPAY) is a housing scheme launched by the government of Gujarat in India to provide affordable housing to economically weaker sections (EWS) and low-income groups (LIG) of society.

fields.schemeName: AGR 2 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme Of Farmers Other Than SC/ST
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “AGR 2 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme of Farmers Other Than SC/ST” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: Agricultural Skill Development Training Programme For Women Farmers And Farmers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Agricultural Skill Development Training Programme for Women Farmers and Farmers” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Divyang People
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipend Scheme for Poultry Farming Training for Divyang People” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to raise the income of Divyang poultry farmers through scientific poultry farming training.

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm For Scheduled Caste
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for Scheduled Caste” was started by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: Bal Sakha Yojana Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Bal Sakha Yojana is started by the Gujarat government (Health and Family Welfare Department) to make accessible expert care by the private paediatrician to all BPL and tribal children born under the ambit (range) of the Chiranjeevi Yojana or in Government Healthcare institution.

fields.schemeName: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 40 R.I.R. Birds Unit For Divyang People
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 40 R.I.R. Birds Unit for Divyang People” was launched by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Govt. of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of Divyang People of the society of Gujarat State.

fields.schemeName: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Schedule Caste
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipend Scheme for Poultry Farming Training for Schedule Caste” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to raise the income of poultry farmers of Scheduled Caste by scientific poultry farming training.

fields.schemeName: Krushi Mahotsav
fields.briefDescription: The Krishi Mahotsav Yojana is an agricultural development scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat in the year 2010. The scheme aims to boost agricultural productivity and increase the income of farmers in the state.

fields.schemeName: NAMO E-Tablet Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Namo Tablet Yojana in Gujarat is a state-specific version of the central government's PM Tablet Scheme. The scheme was launched in 2017 by the Gujarat government and aims to distribute tablets to around 3.5 lakh students in the state.

fields.schemeName: Bhagwan Budhdh Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: Bhagavan Buddha Post SSC Scholarship launched by the Ministry of Education, Government of Gujarat. A scheme was introduced with the aim to encourage SC girl students to continue their higher studies after SSC.

fields.schemeName: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For Scheduled Caste People
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for Scheduled Caste People” was launched by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to uplift economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State.

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Assistance For Start Ups/ Innovation
fields.briefDescription: The "Scheme for Assistance for Startups / Innovation" has been introduced to encourage R&D and start innovation and entrepreneurship at different levels of the startup cycle. The scheme came into force on 07/08/2020 and will remain in operation for a period of 5 years, i.e. upto 06.08.2025.

fields.schemeName: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 25 R.I.R. Birds' Unit For Weaker Section
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Birds' Unit for Weaker Section” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of weaker section people of the society.

fields.schemeName: Janta Juth Accidental Insurance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Janta Juth" is a Farmer's Accidental Insurance Scheme by the Govt. of Gujarat to provide economic assistance of upto ₹ 2,00,000 to Farmers in case of Death or Disability. The objective is to assist the successor of the farmer in case of death or disability due to an accident.

fields.schemeName: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For General Category People
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for General Category People” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to uplift Economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State.

fields.schemeName: Incentive To Owners Of Artificial Insemination Born Female Calf Through Pure Breeding In Indigenous Cow
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Incentive to Owners of Artificial Insemination Born Female Calf through Pure Breeding in Indigenous Cow” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: National Agriculture Insurance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The National Agricultural Insurance Scheme (NAIS/Rashtriya Krishi Bima Yojana) has been under implementation in Gujarat State since its introduction by the Government of India in the Rabi/Summer 1999-2000 season.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Mukhya Mantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY) scholarship is a scholarship program offered by the government of Gujarat, India for students pursuing higher education.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Arogya Artham Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Mukhyamantri Arogya Artham Yojana (MAAY) is a health insurance scheme launched by the government of Gujarat in India. The scheme was launched in September 2012 to provide financial assistance for medical treatment to families living below the poverty line in the state.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched on September 6, 2019, to provide relief and support to farmers in case of crop damage due to natural calamities and was implemented by the Revenue Department of the Government of Gujarat in collaboration with the Agriculture and Co-operation Department.

fields.schemeName: Atal Sneh Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Gujarat Chief Minister Shri Vijay Rupani here today announced the Atal ‘Screening of Newborn for Enhancement of Health’ (SNEH) Yojna to be started in the state from the former Prime Minister Atal Behari Vajpayee’s birthday on December 25, 2016.

fields.schemeName: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of Goat Unit (10+1) For Scheduled Tribe Women
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of Goat Unit (10+1) for Scheduled Tribe Women” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to uplift Economically poor livestock breeders of Gujarat State.

fields.schemeName: Vahli Dikri Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Vahli Dikri Yojana is a scheme launched by the government of Gujarat in India in 2019. The scheme is aimed at improving the welfare of girl children in the state and reducing the financial burden on parents. The scheme provides financial assistance to families having one or two girl children.

fields.schemeName: Coaching Assistance Scheme For Scheduled Caste Students For Pre-Exam Preparation Like NEET, JEE, GUJCET
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Coaching Assistance Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students for Pre-Exam Preparation like NEET, JEE, GUJCET” was launched by the Govt. of Gujarat during the year 2014-15 to provide coaching assistance to students of Scheduled Caste category who are preparing for exams like NEET, JEE, GUJCET.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana is a scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat to empower women in the state. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to women entrepreneurs and to promote their entrepreneurial spirit.

fields.schemeName: Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana focuses on integrated, holistic, and inclusive development of tribal communities. It aims at creation of quality social and civil infrastructure, and sustainable livelihood, employment & entrepreneurship in tribal areas such that the income of every tribal family doubles.

fields.schemeName: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 25 R.I.R. Birds’ Unit For Schedule Caste
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme on Establishment of 25 R.I.R. Birds’ unit for Schedule Caste” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide employment, nutritious diet and to raise the income of Schedule Caste People of the society.

fields.schemeName: Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Sardar Patel Agriculture Research Award” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat on 30.10.1995.

fields.schemeName: Stipend Scheme For Scheduled Tribes - Poultry Training Stipend
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Tribes - Poultry Training Stipend” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to raise the income of poultry farmers of Schedule Tribes through scientific poultry farming training.

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Subsidy On Interest For Establishment Of 1 To 20 Milch Animal Farm For Scheduled Tribe
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Scheme for Subsidy on Interest for Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm for Scheduled Tribe” was started by the Dept. of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Govt. of Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: AGR-50 Scheme-Assistance To Purchase Tractors
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “AGR-50 Scheme-Assistance to Purchase Tractors” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat in the year 2011-12. The scheme was implemented for the farmers to help in buying the tractor in the state.

fields.schemeName: AGR 4 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme For SC Farmers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “AGR 4 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme for SC Farmers” was started by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of 100 Broiler Birds' Farm For Schedule Caste
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Subsidy Scheme for Establishment of 100 Broiler Birds' Farm for Schedule Caste” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat to provide supplementary income to Schedule Caste People of the society.
